quote: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

activation.condition: the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes in the subject's direction; the subject moves out of its lane

obligation.description: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

timing.description: the signal precedes the lane change — the indicator must be on before the footprint starts to leave the lane; a lead time or distance for the signal must be declared; the text says only 'has given'

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: ascertained that such movement can be made with safety
judgment_calls_needed.note: 'ascertained … with safety' is a judgement element about the driver's check; the observable substitute is the gap the target lane offered
